description.en-US: POSTs an event to your callback URL when a new inbox message arrives, signed with HMAC-SHA256 and retried on failure, with deliveries listed on the plugin page. It can also manage an external identity, whose owner replies and answers questions through the callback
description.zh-CN: 收件箱收到新消息时，把事件 POST 到你的回调地址：HMAC-SHA256 签名，失败自动重试，投递记录可在插件页查看；也可以代管外部身份，对方经回调回复与回答提问

description.en-US: An http or https URL. Nothing is sent when it is empty. A project can set its own URL.
description.zh-CN: http 或 https 地址；为空时不推送。项目里可以填自己的地址。

description.en-US: When set, every request carries an x-loop-now-signature header: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>").
description.zh-CN: 设置后每个请求带 x-loop-now-signature 头：sha256=HMAC-SHA256(密钥, "<时间戳>.<正文>")。

description.en-US: Only external identities: sends the messages external identities receive, so they need not poll their Inboxes. All recipients: sends every Inbox message.
description.zh-CN: 只推给外部身份：代替外部身份轮询自己的收件箱；全部收件人：所有收件箱消息都推送。

description.en-US: When on, an identity can be handed to “Webhook callback” on the External identities page: messages and questions sent to it are pushed to the callback URL, and the other side can reply or answer as that identity through the answer URL.
description.zh-CN: 打开后，在外部身份页把身份交给“Webhook 回调”代管：发给它的消息与提问推送到回调地址，对方可以经回答地址以该身份回复或回答。

description.en-US: The platform's external TLS address as the other side reaches it (for example https://loop.example.com:8781). When it and the signing secret are set, pushes carry answerUrl = <external address>/hooks/webhook/answer.
description.zh-CN: 对方能访问到的平台外部 TLS 地址（例如 https://loop.example.com:8781）。设置了它和签名密钥后，推送里带 answerUrl = <平台外部地址>/hooks/webhook/answer。

description.en-US: Network errors, timeouts, 408, 425, 429 and 5xx are retried after 5 seconds, 30 seconds, 2 minutes, 10 minutes, 30 minutes and 1 hour.
description.zh-CN: 网络错误、超时、408、429 与 5xx 会按 5 秒、30 秒、2 分钟、10 分钟、30 分钟、1 小时的间隔重试。
